_comment: Resource Leveling Demo — PMhelper V2 Phase 8
_description: 6-activity project demonstrating clear resource leveling benefit. Activities B, D and F have float and can be shifted to flatten the resource histogram.

educational_notes.before: At early-start schedule: periods 0-2 peak at 7 resources (A+B+background), well above limit of 5.
educational_notes.leveling_target: Shift B (float=5) to period 5 and F (float=3) to period 8-9 to flatten the profile.
educational_notes.after: Peak drops from 7 to 4 resources — a ~28% improvement in moment metric.
educational_notes.key_insight: Activity B has the most float (5 periods) and high resource demand (3), making it the best candidate to shift right.
